music_profile.musical_form: Synchronized with the legends of the goddess
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Paced to the beat of drums
music_profile.sound_description: The soundscape is dominated by the loud, rhythmic pulse of traditional drums, overlaid with the collective chanting of the young dancers. The music is designed to be driving and high-energy to match the physical intensity of the ritual.
music_profile.vocal_style: Chanting and singing by the dancers

basic_steps: Ascetic preparation: Living in the temple and eating simple food
Rhythmic chanting: Learning the songs of the goddess under an asan
Synchronized footwork: Pacing movements to the drum beat
Processional dance: Executing high-energy steps during the temple circuit
teaching.formation: Group synchronization led by a conductor (asan)
teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical stamina and the ability to maintain rhythm while singing.
